semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Siemens Limited Taiwan provides digital solutions that enhance semiconductor manufacturing processes but does not directly supply semiconductor materials or equipment.
summary: Siemens Limited Taiwan offers solutions for sustainable smart manufacturing in the semiconductor industry, focusing on digitizing processes from design to production. Their digital twin technology optimizes manufacturing efficiency and supports sustainable practices.
capabilities: Digital twin technology for manufacturing optimization

regional_presence.Taiwan: Siemens has been present in Taiwan since 1955 and has established itself as a trusted technology partner across various sectors.
